title: Cinematic Wedding Poster Collage
prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic Indian wedding poster collage in 8K resolution.
Scene: A dramatic golden sunset sky over a royal lakeside palace background with glowing lights reflecting in water. The atmosphere is warm, romantic and magical.
Top section: A large heart shape formed from glowing clouds in the sky. Inside the heart, show a romantic close-up of the bride and groom touching foreheads lovingly, soft golden rim light around them, cinematic glow, dramatic lighting, ultra detailed skin texture.
Middle section: Three smaller framed romantic photos of the couple in different poses (holding hands, smiling close, bride laughing), soft depth of field, bokeh lights background.
Bottom section: Full body royal wedding portrait of the couple standing hand in hand on a red carpet walkway decorated with rose petals, lanterns, candles, floral arrangements.
Bride: Wearing a rich red bridal lehenga with heavy gold embroidery, traditional jewelry, elegant hairstyle, glowing bridal makeup.
Groom: Wearing an ivory sherwani with gold embroidery and red stole, royal turban, confident smile.
Add flying rose petals, soft glowing particles, white doves in sky, romantic spark effects.
Text in center:
“Best Couple Ever”
Stylish bold cinematic typography, blue and golden gradient glow effect, 3D glossy lettering, premium wedding poster style.
Color tone: Warm golden, high contrast, HDR, ultra detailed, hyper realistic, dramatic cinematic lighting.
Camera: Portrait lens, shallow depth of field, professional wedding photography style.
Quality: 8K, ultra HD, highly detailed, photorealistic, movie poster look.
🔥 ADD THIS LINE FOR FACE MATCHING (VERY IMPORTANT)
Keep the bride and groom faces 100% exactly matching the uploaded reference photos.
Do not change facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, or expressions.
Maintain real identity, natural skin tone, and realistic facial details.
Ultra realistic face preservation,
